Boomers will, well, go BOOM when they die, stunning towers!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 34 (Formerly, [[Polluted Wasteland II|Nuclear]] & [[Pizza Party|Pizzeria]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Super Slime''', formerly known as the '''Slime''' and the '''Radioactive Slime''', with the latter still being used as its internal name and its name for the legacy version in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, is an enemy that appears in [[Polluted Wasteland II]] and it used to appear in [[Pizza Party]]. It has a high amount of health and an average speed. It has one ability, where upon death, it will explode into a slime bubble, stunning any towers caught in it and spawn three [[Goo]]s. The '''Super Slime''' used to replace the [[Boomer]] in [[Polluted Wasteland II]] and [[Pizza Party]] before their respective reworks; it now only appears in [[Polluted Wasteland II]]. The '''Super Slime''' could formerly be spawned by the [[Nuclear Monster]] before [[v1.23.0]]. It could also formerly be spawned from the [[Mystery Boss]] upon its death from wave 35 onwards. ==Appearance== The '''Super Slime''' is a large faceless humanoid with a waist in its rig. It has a green skin color and a brown torso and legs. All of its body parts are encased in translucent green slime, which constantly emits green particles. ==Strategy== *Use high DPS towers such as the [[Accelerator]], [[Ranger]], [[Pursuit]] and [[Engineer]] to defeat this enemy. *The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be very useful at decreasing the firerate of towers and increasing their range. *The [[Medic]] can be useful at shielding the towers from the stuns caused by the '''Super Slime''', allowing them to deal with the [[Goo]]s spawned by it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseRadioactiveSlime.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- ☢️ NUCLEAR Update!☢️|'''Super Slime''' in the game trailer. RadioactiveSlimeIconIG.png|'''Super Slime''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *This enemy is very similar to the [[Slime (Trick or Threat Town)|Slime]] that appeared in [[Trick or Threat Town]]. *The '''Super Slime''' appears in the trailer for [[Badlands II]]; however, it does not appear in that map in the actual game. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''29 July 2022''' - [[v1.3.0]] **'''Slime''' added. *'''31 October 2022''' - [[v1.4.2]] **Now appears in [[Pizza Party]]. **Health now depends on mode. ***Now has 8,000 health in [[Polluted Wasteland II]]. ***Now has 4,500 health in [[Pizza Party]]. *'''23 May 2024''' - [[v1.23.0]] **Name changed from ''Slime'' to ''Radioactive Slime''. **{{Bug}} The [[Slime]] is now summoned by the [[Nuclear Monster]]'s ''Nuclear Summon'' ability instead of the '''Radioactive Slime'''. *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] **{{Bug}} No longer summons [[Goo]] on death. **{{Bug}} Uses a placeholder icon in the [[Index]]. **{{Bug}} '''Radioactive Slime's''' model does not load in the [[Index]]. *'''22 January 2025''' - [[v1.50.0]] **No longer appears in [[Pizza Party]]. **{{Bugfix}} No longer uses a placeholder icon in the [[Index]]. *'''19 February 2025''' - [[v1.54.0]] **Modern version added. ***Name change is not applied to it. **Name changed from ''Radioactive Slime'' to ''Super Slime''. **Now gives {{Money|20,000}} every 50% health lost. **Health increased from 8,000 to 15,000. **{{Bugfix}} Now summons [[Goo]] on death, though it is still broken in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''5 March 2025''' - [[v1.56.0]] **Health decreased from 15,000 to 10,000. *'''22 April 2026''' - [[v1.89.0]] **Health increased from 10,000 to 12,500. **Size increased. }} ==Notes== {{PollutedWasteland|[[Rusher]]|Wave 18|Super Slime|Wave 19|[[Abomination]]|Wave 20}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Mid-Game]]
